Definition: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
BiblicalUsage: 1) purpose, intent prep; 1a) for the sake of; 1b) in view of, on account of; 1c) for the purpose of, to the intent that, in order to conj; 1d) to the end that
